title: 1RB0RC_1LC1RE_1RA1LD_0LC0LA_1RF1RD_---0RD run ten times further: no halt in 6·10^12 passes
text: The closed pass map of 1RB0RC_1LC1RE_1RA1LD_0LC0LA_1RF1RD_---0RD (c/crun.c) was run from 5.7·10^11 to 6·10^12 passes: 1.4·10^25 frames, 2.4·10^37 machine steps, no halt. One new zigzag start came one cell from a halting row (pass 3,393,707,585,686). The halt-hunt ranking put this run first for its cost; it was worth about a third of an expected halt, and the orbit has now passed about 3.2 expected halts without one.
